summary: Validated iteration-4 prazo customer lookup fixes — backend (cross-store fallback + accent-insensitive) and frontend (label text + immediate list + cross-store badge). 7/7 backend tests pass; all 4 frontend assertions pass on the gym-londres CheckoutModal.

ui_bugs.issue: Store badge has no left margin/space — name and badge run together (e.g. 'PATY DE PAULARunner' instead of 'PATY DE PAULA  Runner'). Confirmed in DOM text and screenshot.

issues: Radix Dialog warnings in console: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' and 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' — accessibility issue, fires on product details modal and checkout modal.

action_items: Add a small margin/space between customer name and the store badge in CheckoutModal.js so 'PATY DE PAULA' and 'Runner' don't render glued together (cosmetic).
(Optional) Add DialogTitle/Description (or VisuallyHidden wrapper) to product details + checkout Dialog components to silence Radix a11y console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate POST /prazo/customers handlers: server.py registers an auth-gated /prazo/customers (gestor required) while routers/prazo.py declares its own non-auth POST /customers under the same prefix. FastAPI uses the first match, so the unauthenticated router endpoint becomes unreachable — confirm this is intentional; otherwise remove the dead route.
server.py is 5849 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline; recommend splitting into feature routers.
test_credentials: gestor / ganoh2024 (used by POST/DELETE /api/prazo/customers in the accent-insensitive test)
seed_data_creation: Test creates and then deletes a TEST_Paulão customer in gym-londres inside test_lookup_accent_insensitive_paulao (auto-cleanup via try/finally).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend prazo lookup with cross-store fallback works as designed. Frontend CheckoutModal prazo flow verified end-to-end on gym-londres: clicking 'add-to-cart-X' opens a product details dialog → click 'Adicionar' to add → open via [data-testid=cart-button] → click [data-testid=checkout-button] → fill [data-testid=customer-name-input] → click [data-testid=payment-prazo] → list appears under [data-testid=prazo-search-input] with rows [data-testid^=prazo-customer-]. Only cosmetic issue: missing space between customer name and store badge.
rca of the issue: Original bug: (a) hard-coded 2-char gate in JSX prevented the list from rendering until 2 chars typed; (b) backend lookup filtered strictly by store, so 'Pau' in gym-londres returned empty. Fix verified: gate removed, fallback returns runner customers when current store has no match, badge marks cross-store rows.
